column4: Step-by-Step Process Flow on Website
1. Citizen opens website URL in browser. 2. Animated splash screen displays portal branding. 3. Glassmorphism cards and bottom nav load. 4. Taken to Home page.

1. Lands on Home. 2. Auto-rotating civic banners cycle (Swachh Survekshan, Water, Drainage, Green, C&D). 3. Services grid shows 12 complaint categories. 4. Recent activity live feed. 5. Live stats counters.
column8: src/pages/Home.tsx. Primary public citizen entry point.

column4: 1. Clicks language button in navbar (हिन्दी / English). 2. Selects Hindi or English. 3. Preference saved in browser localStorage. 4. All labels, buttons and messages switch instantly.

1. Opens /auth and picks Login or Register. 2. Register: name, phone, password -> Submit -> account created. 3. Login: email & password with eye toggle. 4. Redirects to Home. 5. Continue as Guest available.
column8: src/pages/AuthPage.tsx. Citizen authentication via email + password.

column4: 1. Clicks 'Report Issue' on Home or (+). 2. Selects department. 3. Enters description. 4. Name/phone auto-filled. 5. Attaches photo with GPS watermark. 6. Clicks Submit -> ticket number generated. 7. Complaint enters Pending queue.
column8: src/pages/ComplaintForm.tsx. Core citizen complaint submission flow.

column4: 1. Clicks 'Add Photo' in form. 2. File picker / camera opens. 3. Lat/Long coordinates + address + timestamp watermarked onto photo. 4. Validated and compressed under 4 MB. 5. Uploaded to cloud storage.
1. Clicks 'Detect My Location'. 2. Browser requests GPS permission. 3. Coordinates sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim reverse-geocoding. 4. Address auto-fills. 5. Manual picker fallback.

1. Opens /track. 2. Enters ticket number (e.g. IMC-2026-00020). 3. Fetches complaint record. 4. Status timeline displayed: Pending -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Verified & Closed. 5. Resolution photo shown when available.
column8: src/pages/TrackComplaint.tsx. Open lookup for all visitors.

column4: 1. Staff marks Resolved with proof photo. 2. Citizen opens /track. 3. Satisfied: clicks 'Verify & Close' -> status Verified & Closed. 4. Not satisfied: clicks 'Reassign' with reason -> escalated to Verifier. 5. Staff blocked from self-verification.
1. Staff or Admin rejects complaint and enters reason. 2. Status updated to 'Rejected'. 3. Citizen checks /track -> rejection reason displayed clearly.
1. Staff opens /dept/login. 2. Enters staff code and password. 3. Role and department loaded from database. 4. Redirects to /dept/dashboard.
1. D01 Dashboard overview & pending counts. 2. D02 Complaint Queue: unassigned tickets & deadlines. 3. D03 Workspace: ticket detail, citizen details, action buttons to allot or resolve.

1. Dept Head or Supervisor opens Allot modal. 2. Selects subordinate staff from hierarchy. 3. Allots task with instructions and deadline. 4. Reassignment: Supervisor+ can reassign with mandatory reason. Field staff blocked.
1. Opens Bulk Allocation panel. 2. Filters by ward or department. 3. Selects multiple tickets via checkboxes. 4. Selects target worker. 5. Clicks 'Allocate All' -> batch-assigned.
1. Opens Location Filter. 2. Selects ward or enters radius (0.5 to 30km). 3. Nearby complaints listed and shown on map. 4. Batch-allots to field workers.

1. Staff opens resolution form on assigned complaint. 2. Adds resolution remarks. 3. Uploads completion photo (GPS watermarked). 4. Submits -> status changes to 'Resolved'. 5. Citizen notified to verify.
1. Operator opens /control-room. 2. Views live map of complaint routes. 3. Reroutes misclassified tickets to correct department. 4. Sets priority H0 (Critical) to H3. 5. Escalates complaints.
1. Citizen disputes resolution or no response. 2. Senior staff or Verifier opens /verifier. 3. Examines evidence, remarks, photos. 4. Decisions: Rework, Verified as resolved, Request info, or Refer.
1. Supervisor selects Reassign on complaint. 2. Chooses new assignee from hierarchy. 3. Enters reason. 4. Previous assignee notified and removed; new assignee gets task in queue.
column8: src/components/dept/AllotModal.tsx. Workflow reassignment with audit trail.

column4: 1. Admin opens /admin. 2. Enters credentials -> verified. 3. Municipal Dashboard loads: Power BI style workload charts, performance comparison, SLA compliance (<24h, 24-72h, >72h).
1. Admin configures 6-tier structure: Commissioner -> Deputy Commissioner -> Dept Head -> Area Officer -> Supervisor -> Operational Staff. 2. Permissions enforced across all actions.
1. Admin opens Staff Registration. 2. Enters staff code, name, phone, ward, department, role. 3. Account created. 4. Staff Approvals tab allows reviewing, editing designation, or revoking access.
1. Configures 12 civic departments (Green, Water, Rainwater, C&D, Clean, Roads, Streetlight, Sewage, Parks, Electricity, Solid Waste, Noise) with slugs, icons, and colors.
1. Admin or Dept Head opens Ward Registration. 2. Enters ward number, name, Hindi name, radius, and center GPS. 3. Links ward to staff and complaints.
1. Admin opens User Directory. 2. Searches citizens, officers, and admins. 3. Filters by role or department. 4. Inspects complaint history and contact info.
1. Admin opens All Complaints. 2. Filters by status, department, ward. 3. Inspects photo, citizen, GPS. 4. Actions: Mark In Progress, Resolve with photo, Reject with reason, or Admin Verify & Close.
1. Admin opens resolution panel on complaint. 2. Enters officer/team name and work details. 3. Uploads completion photo. 4. Closes ticket directly or sets In Progress.
1. Admin opens Leaderboard tab. 2. All officers ranked by assigned, resolved, and avg resolution time. 3. Computes automated performance score. 4. Filterable by department and role.
1. Citizen submits local news post. 2. Post enters admin moderation queue. 3. Admin reviews content & photo. 4. Clicks Approve & Publish Live or Reject with reason.
1. Real-time query to complaints table. 2. Animated counters for Total, Pending, In Progress, Resolved, Verified. 3. Department and admin dashboards show filtered scopes.
1. Complaint status changes in database. 2. Notification sent to citizen, assigned officer, or admin. 3. Admin can broadcast custom alerts from Push Notifications console.
1. Citizen posts civic thought, event, or alert on /news. 2. Displays on Home news cards. 3. Users like, comment, reshare, follow authors.
1. Supabase Row-Level Security on all tables. 2. Citizens read/write own complaints. 3. Staff read own department. 4. Admin full access. 5. Environment variable security.
